title: Personality Application.
content:
This application is a personnel application in a company to make it easier for all employees to see their personal data in company records..

In this application there are many features that can be opened by employees, including :

  • View remaining annual leave.
  • View employee benefits.
  • Leave requests to our superiors.
  • Approval of leave from superiors.
  • Requests for claims for travel and meal allowances.
  • View work and leave schedules.
  • Look at our self-assessments from superiors on each user profile.
  • View our check-in and return absences, as well as see the results of our overtime hours in a month.
  • And this application will be enabled with many other applications to be integrated.

title: App Learning.
content:
Detail

This is a web-based application used by the HRD program to provide learning materials about other departments to all employees. So employees have knowledge of other departments as well.

The features in this application are :

  • Video learning material.
  • Pretest and posttest questions.
  • Assignment questions for each material in class.
  • In each class there will be a designated trainer for each and the trainer will assess the results of the assignment of employees who have worked on it.
  • In each class of employees who have been determined, values ​​can be taken and ranking in each period of who is the best.
  • View work and leave schedules.
  • This application is also partly used by each superior to provide an employee assessment for the performance of subordinates which will affect the year-end assessment.
  • And this application will be enabled with many other applications to be integrated.

title: Production Daily Report
content:
Detail

This is a web-based application that is installed for each machine to record production results on each machine, where if 1 machine has finished producing 1c product, the operator will press the application 1 time. This application used to be called LHP (Laporan Harian Produksi) which was installed on the tablet of each machine.

The features in this application are :

  • Record production results OK, NG, and repair.
  • Record the history of machine repairs.
  • Determine production targets based on cycle time and working time with downtime.
  • This data can be used for the purposes of seeing the performance of each operator.
  • For other features will be explained further in the next project.

title: Production achievement monitoring dashboard .
content:
This is a dashboard web-based application that functions to see production achievements from integrated data from my previous LHP (Laporan Harian Produksi) project.

The features in this application are :

  • Achievement of production per hour.
  • Total production achievement per machine.
  • Total hours of downtime in each shift.
  • See the performance of each machine and operator.
  • Andon normal machine, downtime, or not operating.
  • See the type of product that is being produced.
  • Seeing the OK ratio, NG ratio, and Repair ratio in the total production produced.

title: Eelectric Corrective Maintenance.
content:
This is a web-based application that can be used also on mobile. Maintenance department application to monitor machine problems / downtime on the production line, which is integrated in real time from my previous LHP (Laporan Harian Produksi) project.

The features in this application are :

  • Monitoring machines that are having problems in real time.
  • View the problem log on each machine.
  • Seeing the performance of the maintenance team in dealing with a problem.
  • And actually it can still be developed further with many more useful features by integrating with other applications.

title: Production Dashboard.
content:
This is a web-based application with a PHP Framework program with Oracle and SQL Server Database. On this dashboard, you can see production achievements on each line, even with other departments.

The features in this application are :

  • Production achievement graph for a year, per month, per day, and shift.
  • Detail line stop on each line.
  • Details of employees who are absent or replacement of members.
  • Production defect percentage dan details
  • Achievement Performance, Quality, Availability, and overtime

Maintenance Dashboard.

This is a web-based application with a PHP Framework program with Oracle and SQL Server Database. On this dashboard, you can see detailed problem information and part monitoring for engine replacement.

The features in this application are :

  • Checking member attendance.
  • The engine ratio that experiences the most frequent issues.
  • The total downtime of the engine.
  • Monitoring cheeksheet machine.

Quality Dashboard.

This is a web-based application with a PHP Framework program with Oracle and SQL Server Database. In this dashboard application, it facilitates the monitoring of claim data from both suppliers and customers.

The features in this application are :

  • Monitoring claim from supplier.
  • Monitoring claim from customer.
  • Monitoring claim data from each supplier.
Detail

Human Resource Dashboard.

This is a web-based application with a PHP Framework program with Oracle and SQL Server Database. In this dashboard, we can view various employee data under personnel, such as gender ratio, total employee count, and employee age. It also includes financial data for the company and plans for additional staffing.

The features in this application are :

  • The employee age ratio.
  • Monitoring the gender ratio of employees.
  • Monitoring employee salary costs.
  • Monitoring the total overtime hours of employees.
  • Overtime ratio for each department.
  • Monitoring planned versus actual overtime hours.
  • Monitoring employee medical treatment costs.
  • Comment feature on data to facilitate discussion among users.
  • Monitoring the planned target vs. the actual number of employees.
